packet.headline_seed: UK Visa Portal spilled thousands of applicants’ passports and selfies online — and hasn’t fixed the leak
packet.description_seed: The third-party website exposed applicants' sensitive documents as part of the U.K. visa application process. Instead of fixing the issue, the company sent attorneys.
